rt:param.name: Grad_Style
rt:param.comment: Индикатор имеет градиентную заливку - объёмный фон

rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub BGColor () Dim BadQ As Boolean Dim res As Boolean res = False NoGrad = False
BadQ = false
If pv_1 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_1.PVId, False) Then If pv_1.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = True Else res = (pv_1.Value != 0) End If End If Else body.fill = Color_ErLink NoGrad = True Exit Sub End If If pv_2 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_2.PVId, False) Then If pv_2.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = true Else res = res || (pv_2.Value != 0) End If End If End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then If !PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_3.PVId, False) Then If pv_3.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then BadQ = true Else res = res || (pv_3.Value != 0) End If End If End If
If BadQ Then body.fill = Color_Inval NoGrad = True ElseIf res Then body.fill = Col_ON Else body.fill = Col_OFF End If End Sub

Sub CheckLocalGroup () In_Group = (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_1) > 0) If pv_2 != Nothing Then In_Group = In_Group || (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_2) > 0) End If If pv_3 != Nothing Then In_Group = In_Group || (PRJSPEC.GRP_In(PointID_3) > 0) End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (PointID_1 != "NULL") then pv_1 = BIN(PointID_1) Else body.fill = Color_ErLink End If If (PointID_2 != "NULL") then pv_2 = BIN(PointID_2) End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") then pv_3 = BIN(PointID_3) End If

Dim MsgStr As String If PointID_1 == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_1 == nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 1 = "" + PointID_1 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv_2 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 2 = "" + PointID_2 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv_3 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 3 = "" + PointID_3 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 == "NULL") && (PointID_3 == "NULL")) Then Call_Win("wi_BIN", PointID_1) Else Dim s As String s = PointID_1 If (PointID_2 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_2 End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") Then s = s + "|" + PointID_3 End If Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

Dim MsgStr As String If PointID_1 == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_1 == nothing) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 1 = "" + PointID_1 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 != "NULL") && (pv_2 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 2 = "" + PointID_2 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_3 != "NULL") && (pv_3 == nothing)) Then MsgStr = "Ошибка привязки.
Вход 3 = "" + PointID_3 + """ ShowWarning (MsgStr, 0) ElseIf ((PointID_2 == "NULL") && (PointID_3 == "NULL")) Then LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_1 + "|BINi|wi_BIN " + PointID_1) Else TmpBuffer(0) = PointID_1 If (PointID_2 != "NULL") Then TmpBuffer(1) = PointID_2 End If If (PointID_3 != "NULL") Then TmpBuffer(2) = PointID_3 End If LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_1 + "|NONi|")
